welcome.welcomeTitle: A Warm Welcome to Haden's Airbnb
welcome.guestThankYou: Thank you for being our guest! We're delighted to have you stay.
welcome.guideIntro: This digital guide is here to provide you with all the information you need for a comfortable and convenient stay. Whether you need instructions for the appliances, details about the Wi-Fi, or guidance on recycling, you'll find it here in your own language.
welcome.languageSelectionInfo: Simply choose your language from the selection box at thetop of the page to view the guide in your preferred language.
footer.footerMessage: If you have further questions, send a message to Haden via the {airbnbAppLink}.
instructions.front-door.title: Front Door
instructions.front-door.step.0.segment.1: ✅ When you leave the house, simply pull the door closed without further locking
instructions.front-door.step.0.segment.2: ✅ When you return, simply use your key on the top lock to gain entry
instructions.front-door.step.0.segment.3: ⛔ Do not use the bottom lock at all!
instructions.front-door.step.1.segment.1: ⛔ Please never bolt the door or use the safety catch when inside the house
instructions.front-door.step.1.segment.2: ❗This will mean that the host cannot get into the house!
instructions.back-door.title: Back Door
instructions.back-door.step.0.segment.0: Turn the knob counter-clockwise until you hear a beep, pull down on the door handle to open the door!
instructions.back-door.step.0.segment.1: ❗ If you close the door, it will automatically lock itself after a short period,
instructions.back-door.step.1.segment.0: When you come back inside, please close the door and pull the handle upwards and it will lock.
instructions.kitchen.title: Kitchen
instructions.kitchen.step.0.segment.0: Turn on the kitchen lights using the green flashing switch
instructions.kitchen.step.1.segment.0: You are welcome to use the kitchen to store and make food during your stay. Please help yourself to tea and coffee!
instructions.bathroom.title: Bathroom
instructions.bathroom.step.0.segment.0: If using the shower, please switch on the extractor fan and open the window to prevent steam build up
instructions.coffee.title: Coffee Machine
instructions.coffee.step.0.segment.0: Confusingly, there are currently 2 coffee machinesin the kitchen, please use the Tassimo branded machine next to the oven/stove!
instructions.coffee.step.1.segment.0: Even more confusingly, the coffee pods are over the other side of the kitchen next to the toaster!
instructions.coffee.step.2.segment.0: First, check that there is water in the refill jug at the back of the coffee mahine.
instructions.coffee.step.3.segment.0: Pull up the shiny chrome head to reveal the old capsule, replace with a new capsule in the same direction
instructions.coffee.step.4.segment.0: Press the large button on the front of machine
